activity.notes: ATLAS uses 628 as Brahmagupta's representative scholarly milestone. Brahmagupta states that he composed the Brahmasphutasiddhanta at Bhillamala (Bhinmal), then the capital of lands ruled by the Gurjara dynasty. The polity label is intentionally the seventh-century Gurjara kingdom, not the later Gurjara-Pratihara Empire.
